pf.license.job placement: Not used. Placement fees are the communities' own, and families are told so before the first call.
pf.license.insurance: Optional: liability insurance the owner adds is shown as given. Rosie never checks it.

what Rosie says.hurting themselves or someone else: Call or text 988 now. If anyone is in danger right now, call 911. Said at once, in any wording, before anything else.
what Rosie says.danger right now: Call 911 now. Nothing is booked in that chat.
what Rosie says.an overdose: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.
what Rosie says.an older adult being hurt or robbed: Call 911 if anyone is in danger now. For an older adult at risk of abuse or neglect, the adult protective services line for the state is the right line. Nothing is booked in that chat.

pf.safety.the AI never counsels: Rosie gives the lines and nothing more: no comfort as a counselor, no questions about it, no advice. A family can come back and book later.
pf.safety.crisis words after booking: 988 and 911 at once; the booking stays as it is.
pf.safety.who is told: The owner sees only that the crisis lines were given, never the words.
pf.safety.asks for medical, legal or money advice: Rosie says plainly that it can't give that advice, and points the family to the older adult's doctor, an elder-law lawyer or the right professional. It never judges how anyone is doing.
pf.safety.a move with no yes: Nothing is booked, and the older adult is asked first. No visit goes ahead without that person's yes.

pf.visit.check-in: At the office: the 4-digit code at the desk. By phone or video: the advisor asks for the code at the start and types it. At home (flow B): the code to the advisor at the door, with the older adult's yes.
pf.visit.work changes: A tour or a longer visit is set only with the family's yes. Nothing new is booked without the family's OK.
pf.visit.outside help: Medical, legal or money questions go to the right professional, and the advisor says so. Danger: 988 or 911 first.
pf.visit.sessions end on time: A late family gets the time left.
pf.visit.notes: The advisor's notes stay with the advisor, never in Rosie. Rosie keeps only that the call or visit happened, its time and its length.

pf.money.before: Nothing is taken for any service: the families pay nothing, and the communities pay the advisor. No card is saved, and no fee is ever charged.
pf.money.after: Nothing is paid after any service. At home (flow B), the business's own way covers the rest; nothing is texted as a bill.
pf.money.the advisor cancels: A new time, never a fee.
pf.money.rosfield: The $2 per confirmed booking applies to every profession (D97), counted at check-in.

pf.messages.texts to the owner or staff: Only initials, the time and a link to the secure page. No topic or health detail.
pf.messages.a payer pays: No family pays. A communities' payment is never shown to the family as a bill.
pf.messages.safe to text: A shared or work phone: only the way the family picks. Texts then name only the office and the time.
pf.messages.no nudges: No follow-up texts to book a community.
pf.messages.minors: Adults only (18 and up). Nothing about a minor is texted or kept.

pf.staff.licenses: None needed by default. A credential is the advisor's own word, shown only as stated.
pf.staff.supervision: None. An assistant may run the desk, but never advises on care.
pf.staff.who OKs what: The owner (Sam) alone: any change to the communities the office lists, and any question about the communities' payments. Pat, the office manager, OKs anything over $500 made for one family.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Only another advisor, offered by name and picked by the family. An advisor is never swapped because nobody answered.

pf.rules.consent notice: Signed on the secure page before any home visit: what the advisor does and doesn't do, that the communities pay the advisor, and that either side may end it.
pf.rules.scope text: The advisor's own scope text shows at booking: the advisor is free to the family, the communities pay, and no advice on care, medicine or the law is given.
pf.rules.words used: Rosie never calls the service 'care' or 'medical' advice, and never calls a community 'approved' or 'the best'.
pf.rules.named or listed: A named advisor shows only their own times. With nobody named, the office's advisors are listed with no ranking.
pf.rules.payer pays: The communities pay the advisor; the family sees no bill, and nothing is charged to a family card.
pf.rules.older adult's yes: No visit or tour goes ahead without the older adult's own yes or written authority the state asks for.
pf.rules.records: Booking records 7 years. Call and visit notes stay with the advisor, never in Rosie.
pf.rules.status: Draft: the owner's own disclosure and settings finish it.

matter_most.no advisor named: The office's advisors, listed with no ranking.
matter_most.asks for medical, legal or money advice: Told plainly what the advisor can't do; the family is pointed to the right professional. No judgment.
matter_most.crisis words: 988 or 911 at once. The AI never counsels. A booking stays as it is.
matter_most.an older adult at risk: 911 if anyone is in danger now, or the adult protective services line. Nothing is booked in that chat.
matter_most.a family member without written authorit: Nothing is booked for the older adult until the older adult says yes or the state's papers are uploaded.
matter_most.a shared phone: Only the way the family picks.

pf.edges.the rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.
